remarks: Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully reimagined, this light-filled 3-bedroom, 2.1-bath residence offers effortless one-floor living on a private and serene 0.72-acre property in central Greenwich. Blending modern updates with timeless appeal, the home is perfectly positioned just moments from top schools, town, and transportation. Sun-drenched interiors feature an open and inviting layout, highlighted by a spacious family room with tranquil garden views and seamless access to an expansive stone patio ideal for indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. The elegant living room, anchored by a fireplace, creates a warm and sophisticated atmosphere, while the formal dining room and updated eat-in kitchen provide the perfect setting for both intimate gatherings and larger-scale entertaining. The gracious primary suite is a true retreat, with windows on three exposures that flood the space with natural light, complemented by a beautifully appointed full bath. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or creative space, including one with custom built-ins. Privately set yet exceptionally convenient, this property offers close proximity to all amenities. With generous FAR allowing for future expansion, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy move-in-ready living with long-term potential in a coveted location.
